newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BNDES to help finance Bolivia-Brazil gas pipeline.
newsitem.headline: BNDES to help finance Bolivia-Brazil gas pipeline.

text.p: Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) said it will finance 380 million reais ($368.9 million) of state oil giant Petrobras' investment in the Bolivia-Brazil gas pipeline project.
Brazil is responsible for 80 percent of the $1.8 billion investment in the 1,900-mile (3,000 km) pipeline which links Bolivia's Andean gasfields with Brazil's industrial heartland.
The BNDES funds will go toward building the pipeline, and will allow Petrobras to reduce the price of transporting the gas, the BNDES said in a statement.

Under the terms of an agreement signed by Bolivia and Brazil in September, Brazil will buy 8.0 million cubic meters (280 million cubic feet) of gas daily in the first year of the pipeline's operation, rising to 16 million cubic meters after eight years (560 million cubic feet) and possibly 30 million cubic meters (1.0 billion cubic feet) thereafter.

Petrobras has also agreed to effectively loan its Bolivian counterpart Yacimentos Petroliferos Fiscales Bolivianos nearly $280 million of the estimated $430 million cost of work on the Bolivian leg of the pipeline.
--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
